hook.name: GazzFeeHook
hook.description: A fee hook for gazz.fun V4 pools that charges a flat platform fee (up to 5% cap, deployed at 2%) plus an optional per-coin community fee (up to 2%) on every swap, always taken in native ETH and forwarded to GazzFeeSplitter. Restricted to native ETH pools; handles all four swap directions via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns.
